root_idea.summary: A polarity of elevation or standing and its opposite, falling or prostration.
root_idea.development: The elevated side appears in the hill or mound, while the opposing side appears in throwing something down or causing it to fall. Related developments include the neck, pouring or dropping, and agitated movement.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form تَلَّ.

senses.definition: To throw down, prostrate, or make lie down.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction وَتَلَّهُ لِلْجَبِينِ, the verb denotes causing him to fall or be prostrated. The same transitive action can be used of making a corporeal thing or an animal lie down.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pour something into another person's hand; to give or deliver it into his hand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used of throwing or putting an object into someone's hand.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lower a rope into a well by hand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A use associated with drawing water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To charge or upbraid someone with an evil or foul thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the construction تَلَّهُ سَوْءٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become prostrated or thrown down; to fall or fall down.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Intransitive use, distinct from the causative-transitive use of throwing someone down.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the side of the forehead to sweat or exude sweat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used in relation to a watering-trough.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause a fluid or liquid to fall in drops.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV transitive usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To move, agitate, or shake someone, sometimes violently, putting him into motion or commotion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may describe violently shaking a drinker in order to test whether he has drunk wine or the like.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hard journeying, rough or vehement driving, and hardship, difficulty, distress, or adversity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun is used both for severe movement or driving and for the resulting or comparable condition of hardship.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hill or mound of earth or dust; a heap of sand; a hill rising above what surrounds it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical discussion distinguishes the natural small hill from a colloquial use for an artificial mound.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A pillow; in plural usage, also reported for certain cloths or garments.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural is variously explained as pillows or types of cloth and clothing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A single act of pouring.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A feminine noun of unity associated with the act of pouring.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A single act of lying on one's side.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A feminine noun of unity associated with lying on the side.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mode or manner of lying on the side.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Nominal usage describing the manner or posture of lying.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sluggishness, laziness, or indolence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An abstract nominal meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A state or condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions such as being or spending the night in an evil condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing or matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the expression تِلَّةِ سَوْءٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Moisture, especially moisture in the mouth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal usage equated with بِلَّةٌ or بَلَلٌ in the cited expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Prostrated or thrown down.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive form for one who has been cast down.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The neck; also the cheek or side of the face.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete anatomical noun; it is also used in explaining the bodily endpoint of the Quranic prostration construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A drinking vessel made from the envelope of a palm spadix.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: So called in connection with pouring its contents into the throat; reported as a vessel for drinking nabīdh.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place of prostration.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun of place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing used to throw someone down; especially a spear used for that purpose, and hence an erect spear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is used substantivally and adjectivally of the spear.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Strong or robust.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival use applied to a person, camel, or other entity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who prostrates much or often.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term can describe prostrating by twisting one's leg with another person's leg.

cautions: The Quranic act of throwing down is secure, but the precise endpoint in وَتَلَّهُ لِلْجَبِينِ is variously explained as the side of the forehead, the face or mouth, or the neck; these are not separate verb senses.
